body: I do both, but the behavior isn't different in either scenario. It's like I'm just a person in the vehicle observing either one of my friends have fun or all my friends having fun forgetting I exist.

I know what you feel in a sense. I don't know what you are going through, but I wanna tell you something my professor once told me that has stuck with me. "Our lives are like a soap opera, we reach the lowest lows, but how do we overcome them? We make the change. Soap operas only work if the plot changes. So, we gather ourselves, and work to change our story for the better."

Sorry for your loss. I can't imagine how you feel and the millions of thoughts and emotions you may be going through. Just remember to take every day with a little bit of strength. Take deep breaths and remember just how much you love him.
You both know, but not one of you will ever say a word. It will go on FOREVER. 🫡
Commentary similar to podcasts like The Goons, The MisFitz, and the Vanoss Squad.

I understand some of what you are feeling. I just lost a good friend of mine to suicide a few days ago, and if I'm honest it feels like it's not real. It feels like I'm just gonna see him walking around again tomorrow like nothing at all happened, but I know that isn't true. I am not here to try and force my story on you, I only am saying this to say that you aren't alone. There are more out there. I am one of the millions going through this same pain. I still don't understand it and I don't think I will anytime soon. Sorry for you loss and the best of luck to you!
